+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, Mapping, MutableMapping, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def translate_dictionary_values(
+    data: Mapping[str, Any],
+    source_language: str,
+    target_language: str,
+    model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini",
+    client: Optional[OpenAI] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = client or OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+
+    def _translate_value(value: Any) -> Any:
+        if isinstance(value, str):
+            response = client.responses.create(
+                model=model,
+                input=[
+                    {
+                        "role": "system",
+                        "content": (
+                            f"Translate from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+                            "Return only the translated text. Preserve meaning and style."
+                        ),
+                    },
+                    {"role": "user", "content": value},
+                ],
+            )
+            return response.output_text
+        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+            return {k: _translate_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            return [_translate_value(v) for v in value]
+        if isinstance(value, tuple):
+            return tuple(_translate_value(v) for v in value)
+        return value
+
+    return {key: _translate_value(value) for key, value in data.items()}

+import os
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from html import escape
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+from typing import List, Tuple
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Segment:
+    kind: str
+    value: str
+
+
+class _MarkupTokenizer(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=False)
+        self.segments: List[Segment] = []
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        attrs_text = "".join(
+            f' {name}' if value is None else f' {name}="{escape(value, quote=True)}"'
+            for name, value in attrs
+        )
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"<{tag}{attrs_text}>") )
+
+    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"</{tag}>") )
+
+    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
+        attrs_text = "".join(
+            f' {name}' if value is None else f' {name}="{escape(value, quote=True)}"'
+            for name, value in attrs
+        )
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"<{tag}{attrs_text}/>") )
+
+    def handle_data(self, data):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("text", data))
+
+    def handle_entityref(self, name):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"&{name};"))
+
+    def handle_charref(self, name):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"&#{name};"))
+
+    def handle_comment(self, data):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"<!--{data}-->"))
+
+    def handle_decl(self, decl):
+        self.segments.append(Segment("tag", f"<!{decl}>"))
+
+
+def _translate_text_openai(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str, model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini") -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": [
+                    {
+                        "type": "text",
+                        "text": f"Translate from {source_language} to {target_language}. Return only the translated text.",
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": text}]},
+        ],
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"} and content.get("text"):
+                return content["text"].strip()
+    raise RuntimeError("OpenAI response did not contain translated text")
+
+
+def translate_markup(markup: str, source_language: str, target_language: str, model: str = "gpt-5.4-mini") -> str:
+    tokenizer = _MarkupTokenizer()
+    tokenizer.feed(markup)
+    translated: List[str] = []
+    for segment in tokenizer.segments:
+        if segment.kind == "text" and segment.value.strip():
+            translated.append(_translate_text_openai(segment.value, source_language, target_language, model))
+        else:
+            translated.append(segment.value)
+    return "".join(translated)
+

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Sequence
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+
+
+def batch_translate(texts: Sequence[str], source_language: str, target_language: str, temperature: float = 0.0, timeout: int = 60) -> List[str]:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    if not isinstance(texts, Sequence):
+        raise TypeError("texts must be a sequence of strings")
+
+    indexed_texts = [{"index": i, "text": text} for i, text in enumerate(texts)]
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "temperature": temperature,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": (
+                    f"You are a translation engine. Translate from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+                    "Return only valid JSON as an array of strings in the same order as the input, with no extra text."
+                ),
+            },
+            {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(indexed_texts, ensure_ascii=False)},
+        ],
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=timeout)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+    choices = data.get("choices") or []
+    if not choices:
+        raise ValueError("No translation returned by OpenAI")
+    message = choices[0].get("message") or {}
+    content = message.get("content")
+    if not isinstance(content, str):
